reasons: Funds of $112,219 are short of the $121,819 needed; $31,000 in gifts can't be used because the donor or property type isn't allowed.

final_answer:
DTI 28.4% (B3-6-02: ≤45% for DU). LTV 70% (≤80%, so no minimum borrower contribution required for gifts per B3-4.3-04). Funds to close $121,819. Bank balance $112,219 + gift $31,000 = $143,219 available. Reserves 9.9 months.

Gift donor is an "interested party" — B3-4.3-04 prohibits gifts from any interested party to the transaction (builder, developer, real estate agent, or other interested party). The gift letter does not cure this; the donor is ineligible. Without the gift, the borrower has only $112,219, which is $9,600 short of the $121,819 needed to close. A condition cannot require additional funds or a different donor.

DECISION: decline
RULES: B3-4.3-04
